Settings.title: System Settings
Settings.description: Configure the exchange rate and utility prices used across the whole system.
Settings.confirm_password_desc: Enter your account password to apply this settings change.
Settings.fees_desc: Extra flat fees you can charge on top of rent + utilities (trash, parking, Wi-Fi…). Add them here, then assign per building.
Settings.building_fees_desc: Pick which custom fees this building charges. Leave the amount blank to use the catalog default.
Settings.global_rates_desc: Applied system-wide unless a zone below has its own override.
Settings.exchange_rate_help: Used to convert every USD amount shown in Riel (៛) across the app.
Settings.zone_overrides_desc: Set a different electricity/water rate for a specific property. Leave blank to use the system default above.
Settings.business_desc: Shown on every invoice (printed and sent on Telegram). Leave a field empty to hide it.
Settings.payment_qr_hint: PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB. Printed on invoices so tenants can scan and pay.
Settings.business_preview_note: Tip: open any invoice to preview how this looks.
Settings.invoice_days_help: Day of the billing month invoices are issued and due (1–28; due on or after the issue day).
